name: Gaussian Preprocessing and Voxelization
definition: Computes the voxel-space bounding box and conic matrix for each Gaussian primitive to determine which voxels it overlaps, preparing data for rasterization.
summary: Gaussian Preprocessing and Voxelization converts 3D Gaussian primitives into discrete voxel-space metadata using analytical bounding boxes and conic matrices to efficiently determine voxel overlaps for rasterization.
